review.posthog_relevance: Adds tab-grouping and metadata display capabilities to the session recording player sidebar, allowing users to switch between session, person, and device contexts and retain tab selection state.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: P1.F6.H4 adds the tab-grouping selection and property-to-tab mapping functions; P1.F8.H1 and P1.F10.H1 add device and person metadata views; P1.F9.H1 removes the legacy grid; P1.F13.H3 and P1.F11.H1 wire the tab switching and settings display; P1.F14.H5 and P1.F14.H6 establish persisted state and property-pinning
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the complete implementation of the referenced dependencies and the full playerMetaLogic, so the complete behavior and edge cases cannot be verified. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation of the tab selection and metadata display, not on unverified outcomes.
